subject: Request: short-term credit top-up for 72h concurrency soak
messages:
From: Laura Kim <laura.k@fintechcloud.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Platform Ops <platformops@fintechcloud.com>, Fintech Cloud Procurement <procurement@fintechcloud.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Short-term top-up for upcoming 72h soak

Hi Sean,

We have our stage traffic soak scheduled next week (10/6) to validate concurrency and P99 latency under sustained load. Our SREs estimate we'll need an additional ~1.2M tokens of trial credit (roughly a 72-hour run at target ramp + steady state) to get meaningful signals.

Can Redwood provision a short-term top-up to our trial account for this run? We're aiming for:
- 72 hours continuous soak, concurrency target ~600-800 concurrent requests
- Peak burst windows (5–10 min) at ~1k RPS to spot tail latency
- Test will use your hosted API (redwood-us-west region) and pinned model: rdx-large-v2 (we'll provide prompt set)

Attachments: poc-load-plan.xlsx (high level phases), soak-test-runbook.pdf (SRE checklist).

Please let me know what you need from procurement to approve — if a short addendum or a one-off promo code will suffice, that would be easiest.

Thanks,
Laura Kim
Engineering Manager, Platform
Fintech Cloud

On Tue, Sep 29, 2026 at 08:09 AM Platform Ops <platformops@fintechcloud.com> wrote:
> Quick note: we want this to run during our low-traffic window but with full load to validate autoscaling.

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Laura Kim <laura.k@fintechcloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term top-up for upcoming 72h soak

Hi Laura — thanks for the detail, this is helpful.

We can usually support a short-term trial top-up for POCs like this. I'll loop in Marissa from Solutions to validate the token estimate and confirm nothing on our side will hit quota limits during the peak windows. On my end I can provision an ephemeral allowance once approved by my manager; Marissa will confirm technical fit.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa to confirm token estimate and any model/seq-length constraints.
2) I’ll escalate for a one-off top-up (and include a short promo code if eligible).
3) We’ll schedule a quick 15-min handoff with your SREs to align runbook and warm-up ramp.

Does Thursday 10/1 10:00am PT work for the handoff?

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: poc-load-plan.xlsx (referenced)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Laura Kim <laura.k@fintechcloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term top-up for upcoming 72h soak — token estimate + run notes

Hi all,

Thanks Laura — reviewed the attachments. Quick notes from Solutions:
- Token estimate of ~1.2M looks reasonable given the prompt lengths in usage-forecast.csv.
- For rdx-large-v2, expect avg tokens/request ~420 (including response). Please confirm if you plan to use streaming (streams reduce timeouts but cost same tokens).
- We'll recommend a warm-up phase (12h) with progressive concurrency ramp to populate KV cache and avoid cold-start tail latency.

Operational constraints:
- We can provision a 2M-token ephemeral top-up to cover headroom for burst windows. This will be time-limited to 96 hours and scoped to your account in redwood-us-west.
- We need a brief acceptance (email confirmation) from procurement acknowledging the top-up is a one-off demo allowance — no contract change.

Attachments included: usage-forecast.csv (my annotated numbers), soak-test-runbook.pdf (added suggested ramp schedule).

If Sean can secure management sign-off for the allowance and addendum language, I’ll queue the provisioning with infra.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: usage-forecast.csv
Attachment: soak-test-runbook.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Short-term top-up for upcoming 72h soak — approval

Approved.

Ben Carter
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Notes: Approve 2M-token ephemeral top-up for Fintech Cloud for up to 96 hours. Offer includes a one-time 10% promo on overage for this POC; condition: procurement must confirm in reply that they accept the terms (no contract modification). Sean — proceed to provision and send acceptance template to procurement.

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Laura Kim <laura.k@fintechcloud.com>, Platform Ops <platformops@fintechcloud.com>, Fintech Cloud Procurement <procurement@fintechcloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term top-up for upcoming 72h soak — provisioning and acceptance

Hi Laura / Platform Ops / Procurement team —

Good news: Ben approved a 2,000,000-token ephemeral top-up scoped to your account in redwood-us-west, valid for 96 hours from activation. Marissa validated the forecast and attached an annotated runbook (see link).

Action for procurement: please reply to this thread with a short confirmation sentence acknowledging that Fintech Cloud accepts the allowance as a one-off POC credit and understands there is no change to your existing contract. Example reply: "Fintech Cloud confirms acceptance of the 2M-token POC allowance and acknowledges this is a one-time trial credit with no contract modification."

Once we receive that confirmation I will:
- Provision the token allowance (we can schedule activation to begin at your requested start time)
- Provide a promo code for 10% overage discount during the 96-hour window (if you exceed allowance)
- Join the 15-minute handoff call (10/1 10:00am PT) to walk the ramp plan if that still works

Thanks — looking forward to the run.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
